{{Quote|Wanna buy some Rancor nail blades?''"<br />"''Not today, friend.|Elan Sel'Sabagno, attempting to sell Rancor nail blades to Jango Fett|<ref name="Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter" />}}
'''Rancor nail blades''' were an edged weapon crafted from the nails of [[Rancor/Legends|rancors]],<ref name="Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter" /> [[Diet/Legends|carnivorous]] [[Species/Legends|creatures]] which grew to be 5&ndash;19 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall on average.<ref name="Character Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC Note">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']] to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. The scene from ''[[Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter]]'' in which [[Elan Sel'Sabagno/Legends|Elan Sel'Sabagno]] offers [[Rancor/Legends|Rancor]] nail blades to [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] takes place shortly before the film's [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|assassination attempt]] on [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]].</ref> the [[Balosar (species)/Legends|Balosar]] [[Elan Sel'Sabagno/Legends|Elan Sel'Sabagno]] was selling Rancor nail blades at the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter" /> the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Coruscant">{{CSWECite|I|146|Coruscant}}</ref> Shortly before an [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|assassination attempt]] on [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] of the Republic was made that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the dealer attempted to sell the blades to the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], but the [[Human/Legends|Human]] declined Sel'Sabagno's offer.<ref name="Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rancor nail blades were first mentioned in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] young-readers book ''[[Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter]]'', which was written by [[Eric Arnold]] and published by [[Random House]] in [[2002]]. The blades are mentioned in the book's third chapter, which is titled "Partners."<ref name="Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter" />
